question.text: Water sample is called cleanest on the basis of which one of the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>BOD</mi></math> values given below :

solution.text: Clean water would have <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>BOD</mi></math> value of less than <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>ppm</mi></math> whereas highly polluted water could have a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>BOD</mi></math> value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>17</mn><mo> </mo><mi>ppm</mi></math> or more.
